OPLL preset tone data
=====================
Copyright free OPLL(x) ROM patches
(C) David Viens, Hubert Lamontagne
Licensed under CC BY-SA.

Source: https://github.com/plgDavid/misc/wiki/Copyright-free-OPLL%28x%29-ROM-patches
Upstream license wording: "License: Attribution-ShareAlike CC BY-SA"
The source does not specify a license version or a license-text URL.
We retain that designation; we do not assign version 4.0 or another version.

Used by openMSX_Y8960 commit 78469c4a0c2010f3252f1c55267f4036ccf8fd74,
src/sound/YM2413NukeYKTBanked.cc, the OPLL-X, OPLL-P and VRC7 preset tables.
The fork represents the parameters as C++ Patch fields rather than the
original eight-byte rows. This distribution makes no further changes to
the fork's emulator code or tone tables. This is not a claim of byte-for-byte
identity with the original wiki data.

The tone data retains its separate CC BY-SA notice. It is not relicensed
under the demo's MIT license or automatically under the emulator's GPL.
Attribution and license notices are retained in source and binary packages.
No endorsement by the authors is implied.

The original "copyright safe" description explains the authors' recreation
of the sounds by ear, rather than an exact copy of the original ROM data.
It is not a public-domain dedication or a waiver of CC BY-SA conditions.

Recorded 2026-09-13. The unspecified license version remains an uncertainty;
this notice does not claim GPL compatibility or resolve the legal treatment
of embedding the tables in the executable. See the release review record.
